visual_findings: All 69 sampled frames were reviewed: many public approaches, group interactions, hotel review sessions and a long seated testimonial.
Faces are usually blurred, but bodies, locations, companions and conversation context remain sensitive.
Frames do not verify the student's business/relationship biography, anxiety percentages, contact validity or later outcomes.

limitations: Automatic transcript was not word-for-word audio checked.
Sparse frames and edited clips do not provide continuous consent or outcome verification.
Same-upload reuse is strongly supported despite different ASR segmentation.
